profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Why work with me?
- I have a proven track record of iteratively delivering complex, high impact projects affecting millions of end users.
- I routinely jump into new technical areas, deeply understand a problem, and align coworkers on the solution.
- I’m self-motivated and proactively identify system improvements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
R&D team lead for novel geomagnetic indoor positioning technology that works on Android and iOS:
- Implemented state-of-the-art data science techniques, using Python for exploratory data analysis.
- Designed the technology to be scalable to a global customer base.
- Developed efficient data structures and algorithms to minimise battery usage (C++, Java, Swift).
- Mentored junior engineers and provided technical consultancy to sales / marketing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led projects to modernize a mapping service for indoor and city-scale environments:
- Designed & implemented a new vector tiles-based system, reducing map production time by 75% (TypeScript, Node.js, Mapbox GL).
- Implemented a multi-tenanted backend architecture that reduced cloud hosting costs by 50%.
- Implemented continuous integration / delivery and infrastructure improvements using Docker and Kubernetes on Google Cloud.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with the VC funded startup Flomio to develop their proximity ID-based solutions.
- Collaborated with San Francisco Bay Area clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer (MS thesis: Data Visualisation for Exploratory Data Analysis)
positions.description:
- Developed scientific data analysis algorithms based on information theory in C++.
- Embedded the algorithms into a desktop application for exploratory data analysis and visualisation.

company.name: School of Physics and Astronomy, The University of Manchester

positions.title: Space Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked in the space department to develop a tool using Python that assists with assessment of satellite image quality from the European Copernicus Earth Observation (EO) programme.
- Decreased assessment time by an average of 25%.

honors.title: Tessella prize for best use of software
honors.description: Commended for implementation of novel data analysis algorithms in C++ and innovation in desktop software design for the MS project.
honors.issuer: Issued by The University of Manchester · Jul 2016

honors.title: 1st place, Uber API prize
honors.description: Worked in a team to produce a demo of 'Teleport': a mobile / browser application that leverages the Uber API to transport customers to retail stores / restaurants.
honors.issuer: Issued by LAUNCH Hackathon, San Francisco · Feb 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored first-year university students, leading weekly meetings to assist with their transition into studying physics.

projects.title: Monte Carlo simulation of neutron penetration
projects.description: Used Monte Carlo random sampling in MATLAB to simulate the paths of neutrons through different shielding materials.

projects.title: Numerical simulation of simple harmonic motion
projects.description: Implemented numerical algorithms including the Verlet and Runge-Kutta methods in MATLAB to simulate simple harmonic motion to a high accuracy with low computational cost.

organizations.name: Manchester UAV (Unmanned Arial Vehicle) Society
organizations.description: Software engineer on a team using OpenCV with C++ to develop an automated precision landing system for an unmanned fixed-wing aircraft.

organizations.name: MANSEDS (Manchester Students for the Exploration and Development of Space)
organizations.description: Served as Technology Officer, where I helped lead the expansion and development of the society. This included organising guest lectures and managing the design and production of a small-scale rocket.
